sections.title: Unattended L4 (report 6.2, 6.3, 10.4, 16.1 row 7; python3 .claude/scripts/loopctl unattended ...)
comment: Unattended mode is `autonomy: unattended` + `autonomy_level: L4` (both refuse until the evidence gate passes). These keys say how a run that nobody
watches reaches a person, and the promotion bar. Read from the BASE sha, never from the branch under judgement (CO-11).

keys.name: notify_command
doc: OPT-IN. A program (and fixed arguments) the kit runs to reach you when a run stops, parks or stalls (DEC-31). It is run with no shell,
so write the program and its arguments only: no pipes, redirects, `$VAR` or `;` (wrap those in a script of yours). The message is
never on the command line: it arrives on stdin as JSON and in KIT_NOTIFY_* variables, as plain text with a strict character set. It must be an
absolute path or a name on PATH, and must not live inside the repository (an agent could edit it). The kit never sends anything itself.
Empty = no notifications; unattended mode then refuses to start.
e.g. /usr/local/bin/notify-me   (a script of yours; the kit passes the message on stdin)

keys.name: notify_timeout_s
doc: Seconds the notify_command may run before it is killed. A command that hangs must not hang the run.

keys.name: notify_env_allow
doc: Names of environment variables passed to notify_command (for a webhook URL or a topic name). It otherwise gets only PATH, HOME, the locale
and KIT_NOTIFY_*. Cloud, GitHub, SSH, git and Claude credential families are never passed, whatever this says.

keys.name: stall_run_min
doc: Minutes the driver may go without a sign of life before the stall watchdog notifies (the driver itself is stuck or gone). Not the child's

stall limit (dispatch_timeout_min). Keep it above the longest gate command you run. Used by the in-process watchdog and by `loopctl unattended watch` (cron or launchd, every 5 minutes; an unattended start needs it to have checked in).

keys.name: stall_storm_n
doc: Stalls (a child with no tool call for dispatch_timeout_min, or a child past its wall limit) inside stall_storm_window_min that count as a
stall storm. A storm demotes the effective level to L3 (report 6.3): unattended runs refuse until a human runs `loopctl approve demotion`. 0 = off.

keys.name: stall_storm_window_min
doc: The window, in minutes, for stall_storm_n.

keys.name: promotion_min_prs
doc: The promotion bar (report 6.3): consecutive merged draft PRs, at L2 or L3, before `loopctl unattended promotion` calls the install eligible
for L4. Server-side facts only (a file made from GitHub or CI; never the local event log, which can be forged). The bar is advice for a human; nothing here promotes.

keys.name: promotion_max_correctness_changes
doc: Most reviewer-requested changes of class `correctness` across those PRs (default 1).

keys.name: promotion_max_reverts
doc: Most reverted PRs across the window (default 0).

keys.name: promotion_max_integrity_flags
doc: Most test-integrity flags (a weakened or deleted assertion, a reward hack) across the window (default 0).
